questions.a: idhaa: tongue tip between the teeth on ذ.

questions.q: Sign-off turns: today's group says An-Nasr and Al-Kafirun to the teacher. Everyone else reads the ذ and ز words on the pupil PDF and circles each ذ.
Extend: say five words with ذ or ز to a grown-up.
Which letter has the tongue between the teeth?
questions.a: A) ذ. ذ: the tip of the tongue comes between the teeth.

questions.q: Think again: ذ and ز both have one dot. How do our tongues say them differently?
questions.a: ذ: the tip of the tongue peeps between the teeth (like 'th' in 'this'). ز: the tongue stays behind the teeth (like 'z').
